Only humidity reached nominal significance (coef=+0.294, p=0.027); cure_hours (p=0.054) and press_time (p=0.082) were marginal, and the rest were clearly null. Humidity was the single best-supported candidate and was locked in. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (n=396, adjusted for lab) gave an estimate of -0.104 (SE 0.126, p=0.408), i.e. the sign reversed and the effect was not significant. The exploratory signal therefore did not replicate, so no exposure is confirmed to have a direct effect on tensile_mpa.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
print("corr humidity vs cure_hours:", df['humidity'].corr(df['cure_hours']))
# joint model humidity + cure_hours
d = df.dropna(subset=['humidity','cure_hours','tensile_mpa'])
m = smf.ols("tensile_mpa ~ humidity + cure_hours + C(lab)", data=d).fit()
print(m.params[['humidity','cure_hours']])
print(m.pvalues[['humidity','cure_hours']])
# bootstrap stability of humidity and cure_hours
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for c in ['humidity','cure_hours']:
    ps=[]
    for _ in range(500):
        s=d.sample(len(d),replace=True)
        mm=smf.ols(f"tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)",data=s).fit()
        ps.append(mm.pvalues[c])
    print(c, "frac p<0.05:", np.mean(np.array(ps)<0.05))
